status_summary: No order adding the HUD Secretary to CFIUS was found. A CRS In Focus report updated 2026-08-28 lists nine voting members and two ex officio members, none of them HUD, and reports no enacted membership change. A presidential memorandum of 2025-02-21 states an aim of protecting farmland and real estate near sensitive facilities and assigns implementation to the Treasury Secretary, a parallel step that does not mention HUD. CFIUS real estate jurisdiction remains limited to property near certain military installations, ports and airports.

timeline.event: A presidential memorandum on investment policy stated an aim of protecting real estate near sensitive facilities, with Treasury implementing; HUD was not assigned a role.

title: Add the HUD Secretary to CFIUS to review foreign ownership of housing
